'''Charls Ginsbrack''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he led a scientific team on the isolated [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Barcola]], that was trying to develop new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology to aid the Alliance's war effort. Ginsbrack was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when he was sucked into a hyperdimensional whirlpool that was generated by the new hyperdrive.<ref name="GM" />
